datasheet_identity.title: BAT42W THRU BAT43W SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The BAT42W forward and reverse curves are typical pulsed traces at TA = 25 degC; the capacitance curve is at TA = 25 degC and 1 MHz.

The table also publishes a BAT42W/BAT43W maximum forward voltage of 1.0 V at IF = 200 mA, BAT42W maximum forward voltages of 0.4 V at 10 mA and 0.65 V at 50 mA, and maximum reverse leakage of 0.5 uA at 25 V.
The datasheet publishes no breakdown-voltage value.
